data.script: const before=editor.getText(); const w=new Workspace(); w.loadFolder='all'; w.queryString='Picker QA:'; w.tagFilter='picker-qa,!excluded'; w.setAllSort('name',false,false); w.showPreview=false; w.showDate=false; w.showTags=false; const selected=app.selectDraft(w); if(editor.getText()!==before) throw new Error('Picker changed editor'); app.displayInfoMessage(selected ? 'Selected: '+selected.title : 'Selection cancelled');

const before=editor.getText(); const w=new Workspace(); w.loadFolder='all'; w.queryString='Picker QA:'; w.tagFilter='picker-qa,!excluded'; w.setAllSort('name',false,false); w.showSearchPreview=false; w.showPreview=true; w.showDate=true; w.showTags=true; const selected=app.selectDraft(w); if(editor.getText()!==before) throw new Error('Picker changed editor'); app.displayInfoMessage(selected ? 'Selected: '+selected.title : 'Selection cancelled');
